fuse_1.name: STATIC_OPERATION_SURFACE
fuse_1.mechanism: The terminal implementation contains no delete/unlink/rmdir/move/rename/replace-by-rename/shell/subprocess primitive.

fuse_2.name: RUNTIME_AUDIT_FUSE
fuse_2.mechanism: A Python audit hook blocks normal Python destructive audit events including remove/rmdir/rename, destructive shutil events, subprocess launch and exec/spawn families.

sentinel.name: PRESERVATION_SENTINEL
sentinel.mechanism: Persistent top-level baseline plus append-only watched-path identity ledger. Missing or identity-rebound pre-existing paths freeze mutation.

guardian_of_guardian.name: GUARDIAN_OF_GUARDIAN
guardian_of_guardian.mechanism: Each cycle rechecks the frozen safety-contract digest, synthetic destructive audit probes, own-source AST destructive-surface scan, running source SHA continuity and Preservation Sentinel.

external_guard.name: DEMIHEAD_EXTERNAL_PIN
external_guard.mechanism: DemiHead v1.2 peer independently pins the exact terminal artifact SHA, safety-contract SHA, GoldPrompt bundle and canonical DemiHead parent main before processing the request.

preservation_architecture.claim_ceiling: Application-level Python interlocks do not constitute an OS/kernel sandbox. A broad RW bind mount means arbitrary compromised native code could exceed these Python-level constraints; seccomp/AppArmor/ACL/mount-level hardening remains a separate future layer.

predictive_witness.name: Beacon Predictive Witness
mechanics: forecast is frozen before action outcome
wrong forecasts remain in persistent state
raw context is represented by bounded hashed context
candidate action distribution is learned from contextual/global counts
calibration uses ten bins with shrinkage
Brier score, log loss and expected calibration error are accumulated
state snapshots are create-only; forecast/outcome logs are append-only

demihead_direct_peer.important_non_claim: GitHub Actions peer execution is not proof that a continuously running production DemiHead process on NAS exists.
